newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel says in China partner talk.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel says in China partner talk.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel AG said it is in talks for warehousing and logistics joint ventures in China.

It plans to increase its China offices to 20 by the year 2000 from the existing nine, given the country's increasing importance in both international and intra-Asian trade, the company added in a statement.

Klaus Herms, Kuehne & Nagel regional director for the Asia Pacific region, told a recent meeting of 33 company managers in Hong Kong that China and the Indian sub-continent would be the focus of Asia growth, it said.
By end-1997, the forwarder will have more than 20 offices in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, the statement quoted him as saying.
"India has enormous import and export potential, Pakistan offers interesting business opportunities, especially in textiles, and Bangladesh is increasingly participating in world trade," he said.
Herms said staff numbers in Asia Pacifice were expected to grow by 200 to 1,600 in the next few years.
